objective: maximize worst-pair observable separation under measurement, transferability, purity, duty-cycle and risk constraints
utility_semantics: bounded priority score; not a posterior probability, confidence interval, q-value or conformal coverage guarantee

resource_policy.principle: An unavailable laboratory resource is omitted from the action space rather than assigned an optimistic utility.

collision_energy_design.principle: No single collision energy is assumed to fragment every precursor completely or optimally; energy-response measurements select the useful diagnostic window.

screening_rules.resistant_precursor_extension: add 60 eV only when survival yield at 40 eV remains above 0.50 or informative product ions remain below the preregistered minimum
screening_rules.labile_precursor_refinement: add 5 eV only when survival yield is already below 0.50 at 10 eV or primary fragmentation onset is lost
screening_rules.transition_refinement: add 30 eV only when the survival/novelty transition lies between 20 and 40 eV
screening_rules.stop_high_energy_escalation: stop when precursor is substantially depleted and fragment novelty plateaus or the spectrum collapses toward nonspecific low-mass ions

unsupported_or_unknown_domain.reason: eV, NCE, collision voltage and percent are not numerically interchangeable

isolation_width_design.principle: Isolation width is instrument-native; a numeric value is emitted only for a qualified domain or an observed method setting.

agilent_qtof.source_basis: Agilent Q-TOF quadrupole isolation tune and application methods

unsupported_or_unknown_domain.reason: Orbitrap-style and Q-TOF isolation-width numbers are not assumed interchangeable

hard_invariants: plans do not change current retrieval ranking confidence claim scope or release
predicted observables are planning aids and never confirmatory evidence
follow-up linkage uses only polarity precursor m/z and retention time before candidate comparison
vendor-oriented exports are advisory CSV files and not executable instrument methods
missing or failed follow-up measurements are not negative identity evidence
no fixed collision energy is claimed to fragment all compounds completely or optimally
single-energy data cannot establish an energy-response curve
eV NCE collision voltage and percent are never numerically converted across instrument domains
high-energy extension is conditional on measured precursor survival and fragment information rather than candidate identity
authentic-standard RT actions require an explicit candidate-specific inventory and a positive task budget
ion-mobility CCS actions require explicit instrument capability candidate-specific references and a positive task budget
unavailable resources are omitted from scoring ranking display and export rather than merely downweighted
Agilent QTOF narrow isolation uses the instrument-native approximately 1.3 amu setting rather than an unqualified 0.4 Da value
unknown instrument domains do not receive a numeric narrow isolation width
